answer: The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the oasis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the lotus until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lagoon of the next round. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short.
